breaking.englishSubhead: BAGHDAD · SEP 30 | SHAFAQ NEWS: KIFAH & HARITHIYA BOURSES 157,250 IQD PER $100 WEDNESDAY MORNING, UP FROM 157,000 TUESDAY MORNING (+250, COMPUTED) AND 156,000 MONDAY MORNING | BAGHDAD EXCHANGE SHOPS: SELL 157,750 / BUY 156,750 (1,000 GAP, COMPUTED); ERBIL SELL 157,450 / BUY 157,400 | GOLD, AL-NAHR ST WHOLESALE: 21K GULF/TURKISH/EUROPEAN MITHQAL SELLS AT 930,000 IQD (BUY 926,000), UP FROM 915,000 TUESDAY (+15,000, COMPUTED); IRAQI 21K 900,000 (SHAFAQ NEWS)
